name: Invoice Payment – Invoice Payment Gateway for WooCommerce
author: BeautifulPlugins

sections.description:
Invoice Payment is a WooCommerce payment gateway plugin that enables customers to pay for their orders via invoice. With this plugin, you can offer your customers the option to pay for their orders using an invoice, making it easier for them to complete their purchases. The plugin is easy to set up and configure, and it works seamlessly with WooCommerce.

✨ Features of Invoice Payment

  • Invoice Payment Gateway: Allow customers to pay for orders via invoice.
  • Customizable Invoice Settings: Customize the invoice settings to suit your needs.
  • Easy to Use: The plugin is easy to set up and configure, making it simple to start accepting invoice payments.
  • Seamless Integration: Works seamlessly with WooCommerce, so you can start accepting invoice payments right away.
  • Secure Payment Processing: Securely process invoice payments and keep your customers’ data safe.

Why Choose Invoice Payment?

  • Easy to Use: Invoice Payment is easy to set up and configure, so you can start accepting invoice payments right away.
  • Secure Payment Processing: Securely process invoice payments and keep your customers’ data safe.
  • Customizable Invoice Settings: Customize the invoice settings to suit your needs.

Get Started Today:

Install Invoice Payment and start accepting invoice payments on your WooCommerce store today!

External Services

= WooCommerce =
This plugin created by BeautifulPlugins uses the WooCommerce plugin to integrate the Invoice Payment gateway into your WooCommerce store. WooCommerce is a powerful and flexible e-commerce platform that allows you to create a fully functional online store. By using this plugin, you acknowledge that data is transmitted to WooCommerce. We encourage users to review WooCommerce’s terms and policies to ensure compliance with their data-handling practices. The plugin developers are not responsible for the data handling practices of WooCommerce.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/invoice-payment directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  3. Navigate to WordPress Admin Dashboard WooCommerce > Settings > Payments > Invoice Payment > Configure and enable to start accepting invoice payments.
  4. Configure the settings as needed and save the changes.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free to use?

Yes, the plugin is free to use. You can download it from the WordPress plugin repository and start accepting invoice payments on your WooCommerce store.

Does the plugin work with WooCommerce?

Yes, the plugin works with WooCommerce. It is designed to integrate seamlessly with WooCommerce and provide an invoice payment gateway for your store.

Can I customize the invoice settings?

Yes, you can customize the invoice settings to suit your needs. The plugin allows you to configure the invoice settings as needed.

Is the plugin compatible with other payment gateways?

No, the plugin is designed to work as a standalone payment gateway for invoice payments. It is not compatible with other payment gateways.

How do I get started with the plugin?

To get started, install the plugin from the WordPress plugin repository and activate it on your WooCommerce store. Then, configure the settings as needed and start accepting invoice payments.

How secure is the plugin?

The plugin uses secure payment processing to ensure that invoice payments are processed safely and securely. It is important to keep your WordPress site and plugins up to date to maintain security.

Can I use the plugin on multiple websites?

Yes, you can use the plugin on multiple websites. There are no restrictions on the number of websites where you can use the plugin.

Minimum requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or greater
  • PHP version 7.4 or greater
  • MySQL version 5.6 or greater
  • MariaDB version 10 or later
